errors.text: The alloy is not reconstructed as nominal TaVCrW; the hypothesis substitutes compositions such as Ta-Nb-Mo-W-V and TaNbW, despite acknowledging compositional uncertainty.

The proposed experimental DSC benchmark conflicts with the premise that direct melting measurements are infeasible and does not isolate whether apparent FEP accuracy arises from overlap with the MTP training set.
The cited evidence supports MTP use in refractory-alloy solid-state calculations but does not directly validate liquid-phase MTP-to-DFT free-energy perturbation.
